research:
I found 10 things from roughly 30 Oct to 13 Nov 2026. Only some of them work in India today, so each bullet says who can actually use it. Where a company didn't publish its own page, I've said the source is a news or blog report.

**New tools and features**

1. **Gemini can now order food and book cabs inside other apps (beta, India).** It went to India in Google's November Pixel Drop (10 Nov). **Why care:** you say "order my usual from…" and it uses the app for you. **The catch:** English only, and only on Pixel 10 phones (not the 10a) and some 2026 Galaxy phones. Zomato, Blinkit and Rapido show up on a leaked Samsung app list, but Google hasn't confirmed them. [Google blog](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/devices/pixel/november-2026-pixel-drop/) · [SamMobile](https://sammobile.com/2026/11/13/geminis-ai-task-automation-will-work-with-dozens-of-apps-on-galaxy-phones)

2. **Gemini Intelligence on Pixel 10 now speaks Hindi.** The same drop added Hindi and summaries of long chat threads. **Why care:** it's the first big phone AI update that names India and Hindi. **The catch:** Pixel 10 series only, so most viewers can't use it yet. [Google blog](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/devices/pixel/november-2026-pixel-drop/)

3. **ChatGPT Images 2.6 (4 Nov): GIFs from a photo, plus saved faces.** You can turn a still photo into a looping GIF. You can also save a photo of a person or pet and reuse it in any chat by typing @name. **Why care:** free-feeling WhatsApp stickers and greetings. **The catch:** it's still rolling out, and OpenAI hasn't said how to delete a saved face. That's a good privacy angle. [OpenAI release notes](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes) · [TechRepublic](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-chatgpt-images-2-6-gif-creation/)

4. **ChatGPT's old voice modes end on 11 Dec, and everyone moves to GPT-Live.** **Why care:** people who use voice mode to practise English or interviews will notice the change and wonder if something broke. [OpenAI release notes](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes)

5. **ChatGPT Business Hub (beta, 10 Nov): shops can claim a profile in ChatGPT.** It's like a Google Business Profile. Owners see profile views and website clicks. Open it from the sidebar on ChatGPT web. **Why care:** this fits our "small shop owners at the counter" viewer. **The catch:** it's a beta, and I couldn't confirm it's open in India. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/openai-rolls-out-new-business-profiles-making-chatgpt-just-a-little-bit-more-like-google/)

6. **WhatsApp Meta AI: separate named chats (beta) and text actions (rolling out to everyone).** Text actions let you tap a message to save a number, add a calendar date or get directions. **Why care:** it's the AI most Indians already have on their phone. **The catch:** the separate AI chats are still a beta test. [WABetaInfo](https://wabetainfo.com/whatsapp-is-rolling-out-chats-powered-by-meta-ai-on-android/) · [BetaNews](https://betanews.com/article/meta-rolls-out-text-actions-to-whatsapp/)

**Things people get confused or wrong about**

7. **"Can I connect my bank to ChatGPT or Claude?" Not from India.** Claude's Personal Finance (5 Nov) is for paid US users and can only read your accounts, not move money. ChatGPT Finances came to the Mac app on 11 Nov and links accounts through Plaid, which is mostly a US service. **Why care:** people will see the headlines and try it. This is a "what it is, why you can't use it yet" explainer. **Flag:** PRIVATE already covered read-only bank access, so this needs a new angle and a new keyword. [Claude release notes](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12138966-release-notes?tp=1) · [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/05/anthropic-upgrades-claude-with-new-personal-finance-feature/)

8. **Your free chats may be used to train the AI unless you switch it off.** On ChatGPT it's on by default for Free, Plus and Pro. You turn it off in Settings > Data Controls. Claude has its switch in Settings > Privacy. Switching off only covers future chats; anything already used in training can't be removed. **Why care:** this is a 3-step, do-it-now how-to. **The catch:** my sources are guides (Malwarebytes, Android Headlines), and menu names change often, so check the apps before filming. [Malwarebytes](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/how-to/2026/09/how-to-opt-out-of-ai-chatbot-training) · [Android Headlines](https://www.androidheadlines.com/2026/10/chatgpt-gemini-meta-opt-out-ai-training-data.html)

**Scams that use AI**

9. **Fake AI videos of ministers selling "trading" schemes.** A Kozhikode woman reportedly lost ₹49.2 lakh after a fake video of Nirmala Sitharaman promised high trading returns. Kerala police have registered a case. Separately, on 12 Nov Tamil Nadu CB-CID filed a chargesheet against a man accused of making deepfake videos of CM Vijay asking for money. **Why care:** a famous face in an ad proves nothing. Report on cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930. [Organiser](https://organiser.org/2026/11/13/426021/bharat/fact-check-fake-ai-video-of-nirmala-sitharaman-promises-high-trading-returns-kerala-woman-duped-of-rs-49-2-lakh/) · [ETV Bharat](https://www.etvbharat.com/en/state/tamil-nadu-cb-cid-files-chargesheet-against-man-accused-of-creating-deepfake-videos-of-cm-vijay-enn26111207301)

10. **Voice-clone calls asking for urgent money.** A TPCI and CyberPeace report says 3 to 4 seconds of recorded speech is enough to copy a voice. Tamil Nadu Police say to verify who's calling before you send anything. **The catch:** the "6 Nov bank deepfake advisory" and the CERT-In warning appear only in secondary articles. I couldn't confirm either on an official site, so don't state them as fact. [CareerIndia](https://www.careerindia.com/features/ai-deepfake-bank-fraud-safety-guide-for-indian-students-2026-011-68211.html) · [Tribune](https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/science-technology/deepfakes-genai-amplifying-romance-scams-in-india-warn-researchers-590041)

**Gaps:**
- **NotebookLM:** I found no official change in the last 14 days. Blogs mention a free textbook library (29 Oct, just outside the window) and say it was renamed Gemini Notebook in July. Neither is confirmed by Google, so check before using.
- **Canva, CapCut and Apple Intelligence:** no confirmed launches this window.
- **Claude Sheets, Whiteboards and Meetings:** these are new, but they're paid or work-team features, so I left them out as beginner topics.
